## Problem / proposition

What is wrong, missing, or being tested?

## Authority and constraints

What does TGA own here, and what authority remains with TSMM, TIS, an external protocol, institution, or legal regime?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] implementation/documentation is complete
- [ ] `make validate` passes
- [ ] important negative or boundary cases are covered
- [ ] provenance and public documentation remain aligned

## Falsification evidence

What result would demonstrate that the proposed approach is unsafe, incomplete, or semantically wrong?

## Residual uncertainty

What remains deliberately unresolved or dependent on external evidence?
